_purpose: The neighbours' yards against your own under one sky (2026-11-14, crates/humanity-ship/src/neighbours.rs GLASS_DRAWN; docs/design/sun-cascades.md, 'A neighbour's roof'). Boot with your home on r1: HUMANITY_DEV_START=row_house_two_bedroom node scripts/probe-sweep.js --vantages tests/visual/row-yards-vantages.json (HUMANITY_FRAME_COSTS=1 for the cost files), then node scripts/home-shadow-metrics.mjs --yards <out dir> --arm glass, which fails when a neighbour's open yard reads darker than your own at noon (seen red on the opaque arm). Each view is taken with the neighbours' glass drawn as glass (glass__) and through the red twin, their homes baked all opaque and the hull shut over them as before (opaque__, showcase neighbour_glass 0); nonear__ is the yard without the near sun view at all. Poses in the ship's frame (x east from the street, z south along it): row-yards stands in r1's yard looking south along the terrace's yards, row-green on Row Street Green looking west at the backs of the terrace over the yards. Station clock: 20.15 is noon (home-clock-noon), 15.15 an hour after dawn, 1.15 an hour before dusk.
